# Mohammad Ali Kohandezh

> Mohammad Ali Kohandezh is a PhD holder in IT Management and CEO of Kohan System Farda (KSF), an enterprise IT and AI company based in Tehran, Iran. Professionally active since 2007 across AI products, enterprise IT infrastructure, virtualization, backup & disaster recovery, and cybersecurity.

He holds 10+ professional certifications (including VMware VCP-DCV, EC-Council CEH/CHFI, HPE ATP, GIAC/SANS SEC504/SEC542) and works out of TechElite, the Nokhbegan Technology Growth Center (Masir 21), Pardis Technology Park, Tehran, Iran.

## Identity

- Full name: Mohammad Ali Kohandezh (محمدعلی کهن‌دژ)
- Title: CEO & IT Infrastructure and Security Expert
- Company: Kohan System Farda (KSF) — https://ksf.ir
- Education: PhD, IT Management (second doctorate in progress); MSc, IT Management / e-Business, University of Tehran
- Contact: Kohandezh@hotmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kohandezh

## Services

- [AI & Smart Automation](https://kohandezh.com/#service): AI products, enterprise agent platforms, and automation
- [Infrastructure & Virtualization](https://kohandezh.com/#service): VMware vSphere, data center design, Windows Server & AD, Kubernetes, Docker
- [Backup & Disaster Recovery](https://kohandezh.com/#service): Veeam, Arctera Backup Exec, Veritas NetBackup
- [Cybersecurity & Forensics](https://kohandezh.com/#service): penetration testing, incident forensics, security auditing
